content.text: Findings: docs/internal/FIRST-RUN.md currently walks through init/observe/handoff but has no recovery guidance. `harnie backup <path>` writes a consistent SQLite snapshot of the live store with mode 0600; `harnie restore <path> --force` validates the backup and then overwrites the live store; restore has NO undo, so a bad backup replaces the live state irreversibly. Plan for the next session: add a short '## Recovery' section to docs/internal/FIRST-RUN.md with those three facts and the exact commands. The edit itself is left to the next session — nothing modified yet.
